2608.07088.title: RoRA: Role-Oriented Regional Allocation for Visual Token Pruning in MLLMs
2608.07088.paper_summary: Multimodal large language models (MLLMs) encode images as long visual token sequences, making prefilling and KV-cache storage expensive. Existing training-free pruning methods select tokens by importance, diversity, or spatial coverage, but treat retained tokens as interchangeable and do not explicitly track which object-related regions are already covered. We present RoRA, a training-free framework that casts visual token pruning as role-oriented regional evidence allocation. Given a fixed budget, RoRA partitions tokens into a protected semantic core, complementary context, and fine-grained detail. It first calibrates text-conditioned attention with a positional prior and a prompt-calibrated object prior, then builds Attention-Anchored Regions (AARs) from high-confidence anchors as lightweight proxies for covered object support. Context is explored mainly outside AARs, while a small AAR-guided budget restores local detail; pairwise similarity is used only for context-stage redundancy filtering. Under matched budgets, RoRA consistently outperforms strong training-free baselines across LLaVA and Qwen-VL families, retaining most of the unpruned accuracy even at aggressive pruning ratios, e.g., 96.5% of full performance at 88.9% pruning on LLaVA-1.5, and improving over D2Pruner by about 5% on Qwen3-VL at 75-90% pruning. At a 66.7% pruning ratio, RoRA requires only 0.7 ms for token selection and reduces end-to-end inference time by 24.6%, corresponding to a 1.33x speedup over unpruned inference on an NVIDIA H800.
2608.07088.paper_summary_zh: 多模態大型語言模型（MLLMs）將圖像編碼為長的視覺標記序列，使得預填充和KV快取存儲變得昂貴。現有的無需訓練的修剪方法通過重要性、多樣性或空間覆蓋來選擇標記，但將保留的標記視為可互換，並未明確追蹤哪些與物體相關的區域已經被覆蓋。我們提出了RoRA，一個無需訓練的框架，將視覺標記修剪視為以角色為導向的區域證據分配。在固定預算下，RoRA將標記劃分為受保護的語義核心、互補的上下文和細緻的細節。它首先通過位置先驗和提示校準的物體先驗來校準文本條件的注意力，然後從高置信度的錨點構建注意力錨定區域（AARs），作為已覆蓋物體支持的輕量級代理。上下文主要在AARs之外進行探索，而小型的AAR引導預算則恢復局部細節；成對相似性僅用於上下文階段的冗餘過濾。在匹配的預算下，RoRA在LLaVA和Qwen-VL系列中始終超越強大的無需訓練的基準，即使在激進的修剪比率下，仍保留大部分未修剪的準確性，例如，在LLaVA-1.5上以88.9%的修剪率保留96.5%的完整性能，並在75-90%的修剪下在Qwen3-VL上比D2Pruner提高約5%。在66.7%的修剪比率下，RoRA僅需0.7毫秒進行標記選擇，並將端到端推理時間減少24.6%，相當於在NVIDIA H800上相較於未修剪推理的1.33倍加速。
